messages:
maria_sec: Heads-up — scanner flagged CVE-2026-1234 in our base image layer (libcrypto). Need a coordinated rebuild that includes the patch, updated cosign/KMS signing, and RBAC audit. Can we sync on an action plan? :lock:
vikram_infra: Can you paste the image tag and affected digest? also list which deploys use this base (hosted/dedicated/private).
maria_sec: Affected: gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-22 (sha256:ab12cd...). Used by: hosted-runtime v3, dedicated-gpu pool, and private-onprem bundles. Tracker: https://tracker.internal/redwood/CVE-2026-1234 :eyes:
ellie_sre: If we rebuild we should do a staged canary in dedicated first, then hosted. Need to avoid rolling everything at once during peak.
jon_dev: RBAC note — cosign signing with KMS requires IAM role change for the pipeline SA. Quick policy snippet to add (will open PR):
```
resource: serviceAccount:ci-pipeline@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
roles: [roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter, roles/storage.objectViewer]
```
maria_sec: Also need audit log coverage for both cosign verify and KMS decrypt ops. Retention request: 1y in centralized logging, with an alert for repeated failed verifications.
sec-bot: automated-scan: HIGH CVE-2026-1234 detected in layer /usr/lib/libcrypto.so, score 8.2 — details: https://scanner.internal/results/17298
vikram_infra: Proposed plan:
- Build minimal repro base (strip dev packages)
- Enable FIPS-compatible crypto build for runtime images
- Sign images via cosign using KMS key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/image-sign
- Canary in dedicated pool, run smoke tests, then promote
Commands I'll run locally: 
```
docker build -t gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-22-patched .
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/image-sign gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-22-patched
gcloud artifacts docker images add-tag gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-22-patched gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-22 --quiet
```
ellie_sre: For canary rollout: create 10% traffic using rollout annotation, smoke tests: auth flows, long-running inference warmup, and KMS sign/verify path. Then escalate to 50% before full. Example restart: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime -n dedicated`
jon_dev: I'll own the RBAC PR and add audit log sink for cosign events to stackdriver. PR will include terraform changes to grant pipeline SA the KMS roles and add iam_member for cosign service. Posting PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/542
maria_sec: Thanks. Also run local attestation check and upload SBOM to the tracker before canary. Add the vuln triage notes to the incident doc: https://confluence.internal/redwood/security/image-rebuild-17298
ellie_sre: sounds good — tagging oncall for deploy window. :white_check_mark:
maria_sec: OK team, please comment on the PR and confirm when the signed image is pushed. I'll coordinate the audit log configuration and the compliance ticket.
jon_dev: ACK — will update by EOD and link the rollout playbook.
ellie_sre: ACK :rocket:
